verdict.rationale: The Department's own Certificate of Incorporation page says "Online filing is available on the Department of State's website" and states that online filers receive an emailed acknowledgement with a PDF filing receipt. The forming-a-business page also links the Online-Filing System alongside expedited processing, so the core formation filing can be completed online per first-party pages. The probe's connection reset at filings.dos.ny.gov shows only that automated agents are blocked; it does not contradict human online filing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of online payment within the filing flow (the card-payment instructions describe a paper authorization form), a clear online fee figure (the published "$9" is garbled), and independent or hands-on corroboration of completing an online filing.
